appointments_cancellation_fields.name: appointments_cancellation_fields
appointments_cancellation_fields.value: "appointments"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("appointments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "appointments"."cancellation_reason" is not null)

audit_events_actor_identity.name: audit_events_actor_identity
audit_events_actor_identity.value: ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'profile' and "audit_events"."actor_profile_id" is not null and "audit_events"."actor_provider_id" is null) or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'provider' and "audit_events"."actor_profile_id" is null and "audit_events"."actor_provider_id" is not null) or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_events"."actor_profile_id" is null)

call_participants_time_order.name: call_participants_time_order
call_participants_time_order.value: "call_participants"."left_at" is null or "call_participants"."joined_at" is null or "call_participants"."left_at" >= "call_participants"."joined_at"

calls_time_order.name: calls_time_order
calls_time_order.value: "calls"."ended_at" is null or "calls"."started_at" is null or "calls"."ended_at" >= "calls"."started_at"

follow_up_assignments_target.name: follow_up_assignments_target
follow_up_assignments_target.value: ("follow_up_assignments"."kind" = 'membership' and "follow_up_assignments"."membership_id" is not null and "follow_up_assignments"."queue" is null) or ("follow_up_assignments"."kind" = 'queue' and "follow_up_assignments"."queue" is not null and "follow_up_assignments"."membership_id" is null)

follow_ups_source_required.name: follow_ups_source_required
follow_ups_source_required.value: "follow_ups"."call_id" is not null or "follow_ups"."appointment_id" is not null

follow_ups_resolution_fields.name: follow_ups_resolution_fields
follow_ups_resolution_fields.value: "follow_ups"."status" <> 'resolved' or ("follow_ups"."resolved_at" is not null and "follow_ups"."resolution_code" is not null and "follow_ups"."resolution_note" is not null)

sessions_closure_reason_required.name: sessions_closure_reason_required
sessions_closure_reason_required.value: "sessions"."status" not in ('closing', 'closed', 'cancelled') or "sessions"."closure_reason" is not null
